This matter is taken up through hybrid arrangement.

2. In filing this Writ Petition, the Petitioner being the proprietor of the hotel in question named M/s.
Jaya Hotel, has challenged the order dated 05.03.2025 passed by the S.D.P.O, Pipili and the Additional Tahasildar, Satyabadi in sealing his hotel on the allegation of adulteration of beef in mutton curry.

3. Heard learned counsel for the Parties.
4.
Pursuant to the earlier direction of this Court the Director- cum-Chief Food Analyst, Government of Odisha and the Food Safety Officer, Puri appear through Virtual Mode.

5. Learned Senior Advocate appearing on behalf of the Designation: Personal Assistant Location:
High Court of Orissa analysis of the samples taken from the above noted hotel of Date: 29-Apr-2025 18:48:05 the Petitioner and pursuant the earlier order of this Court, the above noted hotel of the Petitioner has been opened in presence of the Police personnel.

He further contends that due to spreading of rumor regarding adulteration of beef in mutton curry in the above noted hotel by some miscreants in the Social Media, the hotel of the Petitioner in question was sealed.
Due to the said rumor, the goodwill of the above noted hotel of the Petitioner has been hampered.

6. At this juncture, Ms. Rajeswari Pati, the Food and Safety Officer, Puri submits that pursuant to the allegation of adulteration of beef in mutton curry, necessary samples were taken from the above Pradeep Kumar Barik vs State Of Odisha & Ors. ....

She further contends that after analysis of the said samples it was found that there was no adulteration of beef in the mutton curry.
Hence, the shop of the Petitioner has been unsealed.
7. Learned counsel for the State also submits that pursuant to the direction of this Court necessary investigating is going on to nab the miscreants.

8. Be that as it may, since the above noted hotel of the Petitioner has been unsealed and the Petitioner is running the said hotel in presence of the Police personnel, this Court directs the Police personnel to maintain the law and order situation in the disputed area in question and make an attempt to nab the miscreants who have spread the rumor at Designation: Personal Assistant Location: High Court of Orissa 9.
This Writ Petition is, accordingly, disposed of.
Personal appearance of the Director-cum-Chief Food Analyst, Government of Odisha and the Food Safety Officer, Puri stand dispensed with.
(Dr. S.K. Panigrahi) Judge Ayaskanta Designation: Personal Assistant
